personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, mechanical, and typography-driven fitness log designed for maximum readability and zero friction during workouts.

spacing.rule: Rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, sharp containers, and hard alignment. Let typography become the layout structure.

dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a Brutalist app that relies on hard colors, thick 2pt borders, and high contrast.

screens.name: AccessCode (Entry)
screens.purpose: Minimalist gateway where a client enters a 6-digit code or toggles to Host Login.

states.error: Hard red border on input with 'INVALID CODE' in mono font below.

screens.layout: Full-screen stark layout. A massive Space Grotesk headline 'INSERISCI CODICE', edge-to-edge text input for the 6-digit code, and a bottom-anchored solid brand CTA 'ENTRA'.

screens.name: HostDashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the host to create, edit, and assign workout cards (schede).

states.loading: Skeleton grids mapping to the list rows.
states.empty: Signal Red wireframe icon + 'Nessuna scheda creata.' + primary CTA 'CREA SCHEDA'.
states.error: Error message in mono text + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Rigid stacked modules. Top header with total clients. A list of active 'Schede' in high-contrast edge-to-edge rows with thick dividers (1.5pt borderStrong). Sticky FAB or bottom action to add a new scheda.

screens.name: ClientDashboard (Scheda)
screens.purpose: Shows the specific assigned workout split (1-5 days), weekly check-in stats, and overall progress.

states.empty: N/A - requires a valid scheda to access.

screens.layout: Poster-like grid. Massive number showing current week progress (e.g., 'WEEK 3'). A horizontal sequence of thick blocks representing Days 1-5. Pressing a block expands the day's routine. Large CTA 'INIZIA SESSIONE' fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: ActiveWorkoutSession
screens.purpose: The live tracking mode with rest timers, sets, reps, and exercise notes.
screens.layout: Utility-driven. Expandable exercise rows that toggle set history. Huge Mono numerals for current set weight/reps. When resting, a full-screen rest timer (countdown numeral) with a Signal Red depleting bar takes over. Plate-weight stepper for quick weight edits.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Toggle for Light/Dark mode and default language/preferences.
screens.layout: List of stark toggles with explicit ON/OFF labels in monospace font. A visible edge-to-edge switch for 'TEMA SCURO / CHIARO'.

hero_gym.alt: Modern minimal gym interior and dark dramatically lit dumbbell

exercise_placeholder.alt: Person holding dumbbell for fitness workout placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '5 Brutalist Mobile' personality. Use sharp corners (0px radius) everywhere, edge-to-edge layouts, and structural 2pt borders instead of shadows.
Implement a robust theme context that consumes the `dark_*` tokens provided when the user toggles dark mode.

Banned hues: Do NOT use ANY shades of blue, indigo, purple, or default React Native/Material primary colors. The color scheme is strictly White/Grey/Black with 'Signal Red' as the single accent color.

Ensure 'Space Grotesk' is used for section headers/display text (Max weight 500), and 'JetBrains Mono' is heavily utilized for all data numbers, sets, reps, timers, and input fields to give it that raw, mechanical gym feel.
For the Active Workout Session screen, build a prominent 'Rest Timer' that occupies large screen real estate with giant monospace typography when activated.
In Dark Mode, ensure the background is #0A0A0A (not pure #000000 to prevent OLED smearing/eye fatigue) with high-contrast white text.
All primary CTA buttons must be sticky at the bottom of the screen (above safe area) even when the main content scrolls.
Because there is no traditional auth flow, the Landing page must function as a code-entry gatekeeper. Provide a small subtle button/text for the Host to bypass or 'Login as Host'.
